Preserve actual accepted PR #2082 at 7ef13f96c0005b6e181a640005bd867bbc2f63d0: all 285,582 predecessor cells, 792 complete ledger rows and 112 authorities. Add exactly 967 original keys in 62 new rows under 23 genuine qualification authorities, producing 286,549 cells, 854 rows and 135 authorities. The exact delivery delta covers 58 existing targets. Retain the original broader scientific-study scopes.

This combines the frozen reviewed 580-cell contribution from PR #2097 with 387 newly ready keys. PR #2097 and its exact 2d9ba38d7f67c8cbd09dc567385f83ad6f754b0b head remain preserved as fallback. Neither candidate is claimed accepted or superseded here.

- Myanmar #1880: 519 original repair requests (147 prior qualifications, 371 newly qualified after distinct exact-contact applicability adoption, and one ordinary Bokpyin key), plus all 28 original source-conflict questions. Preserve the original 7 Myanmar / 21 Thai display choices, 23 intervals, 26 source SIDs and every original pointer. Keep the missing historical 2,515-byte review artifact explicit alongside genuine new reviews and adoptions. The 371-key study reuses 352 earlier contact observations after exact geometry and scan-closure compatibility checks; only 19 previously unmeasured centres were newly observed. Every complete original negative remains unchanged. The 11 Rakhine parent/topology, 834 foreign-country-reference and 78 neither-reference repair cases remain held. Original physical questions are separate, with 294 still held.
- Vietnam #2061: 357 original repairs, including 9 original qualifications and 348 under the preserved reviewed v3 source-adoption route. All 17 remaining territorial-exclusion cases stay held.
- Indonesia #1884: 61 original repairs and the final 2 original source conflicts. This includes the distinctly reviewed 48-key contribution plus 15 provider-qualified original repair requests at 6353379186dce92ec76b39561dfb5b32b2aad76b. Preserve the genuine 9fa provider qualification vintage and original request-to-existing-owner joins. The 25 earlier conflicts plus the 2 new literal keys must exhaust the full original 27-question scope after actual delivery.

## Preservation and delivery checks

1. Use the existing stock composer and finalizer. The actual composition completed in 20.968 seconds against accepted 7ef. Expanded intervals prove exactly 967 additions, zero lost or reassigned prior keys and literal preservation of every prior row and authority. Every frozen 580-cell contribution remains literal by stable identity.
2. Reuse all 23 genuine completed qualification quartets, original code/input/receipt identities and complete scientific operands. No source, physical or qualification producer is replayed to compose this batch.
3. Use the reviewed provider-aware engineering batch #2108, including preserved v3/provider support and the no-prepass finalizer. Actual selected delivery requires that support to be accepted. The finalizer derives absent read roles once from its authenticated projection and one immutable restoration snapshot. Preserve accepted paths, all prior package declarations in order and every non-input policy field.
4. Construct the existing stock scientific manifest for the exact 58 contribution targets and original prospective baseline pins. Preserve source years, rights, uncertainties, contrary contacts, full study scopes and unresolved questions. The cartographic display convention is not a legal or historical jurisdiction claim.
5. Omit duplicate author validation already performed inside the stock evidence constructor when its exact bytes remain unchanged. Retain final-head/tree binding, public immutable-tree/batch whole-body verification and distinct substantive final review.
6. Root owns final review and the serialized queue. Native credit remains zero until actual selected acceptance and original-question intersections. Exact original Myanmar source28 and Indonesia source27 closure retires each full original denominator. The original repair and physical packages remain open for their literal remainders.
